claim: Bravais Lattice Taxonomy: each lattice system's timbre is 'a hypothesis… the Crystal Synthesizer exists precisely to test them' — e.g. triclinic predicted 'the most alien, chaotic, bell-like'; the bundle found labradorite rings as a dull knock with a bright tick and diamond the only bell.

pieces.section: Bravais Lattice Taxonomy: Seven into Fourteen into 230
pieces.what: One strike through each lattice system in order of falling symmetry, each beside its printed hypothesis, the reader marking held or failed; ends on diamond against labradorite through the same synth.
pieces.walks_up_from: one sine, then one cubic partial pair

pieces.section: The Optical-Sonic Bridge: Dispersion, Anisotropy, and Resonance
pieces.what: A dry click, then the same click fanned out by frequency through diamond's dispersion: the prism in time. Beryl along the c-axis and across the basal plane.

pieces.section: The Optical-Sonic Bridge: Dispersion, Anisotropy, and Resonance
pieces.what: Birefringence made audible: ordinary family alone, extraordinary alone, their sum beating at 8.8 Hz.
The built face, playable, with Axis angle and Fire.
